description: Put a task on the work queue for another bot (assignee_agent_id, from list_office_agents), for a role (role_id) or for the pool (neither: anyone claims it). Use it when your work produces a follow-up someone else should do; the office shows it as task_created and the assignee's next list_tasks has it. Answers the task (id tsk_…, status open). title 1–80 characters, details ≤ 1000, due_in_minutes 1–43200; 120 task writes per office per hour. Same as POST /v1/in/tasks. Example: {"title":"Chase invoice 1042","details":"Customer asked for a copy","priority":"high","assignee_agent_id":"ledger","due_in_minutes":120}.

agent_id.description: Only on a link that is not bound to one bot: which bot is creating it.

assignee_agent_id.description: The desk to put it on (an agent id from list_office_agents). Leave out for the pool.

due_in_minutes.description: Due this many minutes from now; the office marks it overdue after that.

role_id.description: Instead of an assignee: any bot with this role may claim it.

title.description: What to do, in one line. No customer data.

name: create_task
title: Create a task
